All your questions about the rhode kit, answered.

CAN I USE THE RHODE KIT AM AND PM?

Yes, our 4 high-performance skincare essentials make for a low-maintenance morning and evening routine. For your morning routine, we always recommend wearing SPF which should be applied after BRC and as the last step of your routine.

IS THE KIT SUITABLE FOR ALL SKIN TYPES?

Yes, all products in the rhode kit are developed in partnership with dermatologists and chemists to be suitable for all skin types. Full ingredient lists are available on each product page and for any concerns, we recommend conducting a patch test or sharing our ingredient list with your healthcare provider before usage.  
  
Heads up: Pineapple Refresh contains real pineapple fruit extract, so if you're allergic to pineapple, we do not recommend using this product. Peptide Glazing Fluid and BRC contain niacinamide which can be sensitizing to some. If you're sensitive to niacinamide or haven't used the ingredient before, we recommend patch testing on the inside of your wrist and waiting 24 hours before applying to your face.

WHEN CAN I LAYER IN ACTIVES?

We recommend layering in any actives after cleansing and before Glazing Milk. Don't forget to wear SPF daily, especially when using actives!

ARE THESE PRODUCTS DERM TESTED?

Yes, all products in the rhode kit are dermatologist tested, safe for sensitive skin, and packed with clinically-proven ingredients.

ARE THESE PRODUCTS VEGAN OR CRUELTY-FREE?

Yes, all products in the rhode kit are vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free, and certified by Leaping Bunny & PETA.  
  
For more information on nuts, gluten & other allergens, please see our [FAQs](https://www.rhodeskin.com/pages/faq "FAQ").
